HXFix changes on top of HX 0.9.89.4
===================================

Story and missions
- Ending: the final conversation starts (everyone was stuck letterboxed), ending
  explosions work, cutscenes play for every player, not just the host.
- Mission fixes: M02 Tenderloin counts kills correctly, M05 escape gear, M09 ship
  explosions at normal rate, M10 chateau ambush fires once, M15 goals, M03/M04 flags.
- Conversations: only the player talking picks replies; a player killed mid-talk
  no longer breaks the NPC; forced conversations and datalinks queue up instead
  of cancelling each other; everyone gets story subtitles.
- Notes (door codes etc.) survive map changes and reach late joiners.

Players
- Map change: no more client crash on travel, dead players respawn with their gear,
  duplicate names no longer swap inventories.
- Microfibral Muscle aug works, Use Cell button works for joined players.
- Gibbed players leave a lootable body; respawn item farming removed.
- No crash on quitting while the inventory screen is open after the host left.

Devices and weapons
- Security consoles, cameras, keypads, med/repair bots, computers and triggers
  behave with several players.
- Weapon mods, ammo selection and the Change Ammo button work for joined players.
- Nanokeys picked up by anyone open doors and datalink checks for everyone;
  each key is listed once in the key ring.

Server
- Server browser query can no longer lock up the server.
